🤨 🌌 👨 🤷‍♀️   In her 1925 Radcliffe College thesis, Cecilia Payne calculated that stars are overwhelmingly hydrogen and helium.

 A senior astronomer talked her into calling her own result "almost certainly not real." Four years later, he published the same conclusion under his own name

👉 She discovered what the universe was made of, then was told to doubt herself—until a man claimed the discovery as his own.

#Science #Research #Crime
